setup: CREATE TABLE t AS SELECT i FROM range(50000) t(i)

workloads.name: grouped_sum
workloads.sql: SELECT sum(i),count(*),grouping(i%64) FROM t GROUP BY i%64

workloads.name: rollup_sum
workloads.sql: SELECT sum(i),count(*),grouping(i%64) FROM t GROUP BY ROLLUP(i%64)

workloads.name: cube_sum
workloads.sql: SELECT sum(i),count(*),grouping(i%64,i%8) FROM t GROUP BY CUBE(i%64,i%8)
